label: Week 32, 2026
recap:
This week saw a modest amount of AI policy activity, with 16 bill movements and 14 case updates recorded between August 3 and August 9, 2026. Most legislative activity centered on the United States Congress, which accounted for 12 of the tracked jurisdiction counts, while California saw 3 and North Carolina saw 1. Among the themes that surfaced, health care and transparency and disclosure each appeared twice, touching on areas like clinical decision support and labeling AI-generated output. Employment and hiring, infrastructure and energy, and workforce and education each appeared once. Eleven bills tracked this week did not fall into any specific theme category.

Overall, this was a quiet week rather than a dramatic one. No federal documents were recorded, and the activity was spread thinly across a small number of themes and jurisdictions. The movements reflect changes in bill status rather than any bills reaching final passage, and the case updates represent ongoing litigation activity without indication of outcomes.
